claims.text: The resort is located in UNESCO's first Southeast Asia Geopark, known for its 99-island archipelago.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Langkawi is located in UNESCO’s first Southeast Asia Geopark renowned for its 99-island archipelago

claims.text: The resort is at the southeast tip of the island, surrounded by centuries-old rainforest.

findings.quote: Located at the Southeast tip of the island surrounded by centuries-old rainforest

claims.text: Interiors were designed by G.A Design and the architecture by Gensler, in a classical contemporary style with European and Middle Eastern influences.

findings.quote: Interiors at our Langkawi resort with 5 stars were designed by G.A Design and architecture by renowned firm Gensler, channeling a classical contemporary aesthetic with European and Middle Eastern influences.

findings.quote: All rooms offer expansive, unobstructed views of the sea from spacious terraces.

findings.quote: distinct in design with bold accent hues and imaginative paintings by esteemed local artists
